name: Home Assistant Room Lights
author: Jane Doe
description: Adds a light control to the camera view — toggle that camera's room lights in Home Assistant while you watch.

settings.label: Home Assistant URL
settings.help: Must match the network host this extension was granted (homeassistant.local:8123).

settings.label: Long-lived access token
settings.help: Home Assistant → your profile → Long-lived access tokens. Stored privately and never shown again.

settings.label: Light entity
settings.help: The light to control. {camera} is replaced by the camera id — e.g. light.{camera}, or a fixed entity like light.hallway.
